P1.1.text: Invested in the long run | Diamond Hill

P1.2.text: At Diamond Hill, a First Eagle Investments company, we are fiercely committed to generating excellent, long-term investment outcomes and building enduring client partnerships

P1.3.text: We have been made aware that individuals are impersonating Diamond Hill employees on WhatsApp. These impersonators may attempt to gather your personal information or engage in fraudulent activities.

P1.4.text: Examples include a WhatsApp group promoting a free trial membership for investment courses offered by a member of our investment team.

P1.5.text: Please note, Diamond Hill does not provide subscription-based investment courses or investment advice. Diamond Hill does not contact clients or potential clients over WhatsApp, text messages, or from free email addresses such as Yahoo or Gmail. Diamond Hill will not ask for sensitive passwords, financial details or personal identification through WhatsApp.

P1.6.text: Diamond Hill is not responsible for any services or information offered by or provided to unauthorized parties. If you think you or someone you know has been a victim of fraud, please report the matter to the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) at https://www.ic3.gov/, police or other relevant authorities.

P1.7.text: To block a scammer or suspected scammer on WhatsApp:

P1.8.text: Open the chat with the scammer

P1.10.text: If you want to report a suspected scammer:

P1.11.text: Select the three dots in the bottom right corner

P1.12.text: Check the Block and Delete box

P1.13.text: For more on how we protect our clients’ personal information, refer to our privacy policy.

P1.17.text: We are fiercely committed to generating excellent, long-term investment outcomes and building enduring client partnerships.

P1.18.text: We offer a variety of investment strategies in four key asset classes.

P1.19.text: Five investment principles inform our decision-making across asset classes and are the foundation for outstanding long-term investment results.

P1.20.text: Subscribe to our insights to stay on top of your favorite topics.

P2.2.text: We are fiercely committed to generating excellent, long-term investment outcomes and building enduring partnerships. We accomplish this through our shared investment principles and client alignment philosophy.

P2.4.text: At Diamond Hill, a First Eagle Investments company, we are fiercely committed to generating excellent, long-term investment outcomes and building enduring partnerships. We accomplish this through our shared investment principles and client alignment philosophy.

P2.5.text: Our shared investment principles align our investment professionals across multiple capabilities, are foundational to how we invest and support our aim of generating excellent long-term investment results.

P2.6.text: An active, research-driven approach that capitalizes on our intellectual curiosity and unique insights is essential to deliver better returns than benchmarks or peers.

P2.7.text: Investing with an ownership mentality requires deep due diligence to build the conviction needed to invest over the long term.

P2.8.text: Focusing on the long term allows us to look beyond near-term noise, allowing clients to realize the benefits of our deep, disciplined research process.

P2.9.text: We believe the best way to compound returns is to take an ownership stake in an investment at a discount to its underlying value and have the discipline to wait for that value to be realized.

P2.10.text: Prudent capacity management protects our ability to generate competitive long-term investment results for our clients.

P2.11.text: We build long-term partnerships by aligning our interests with those of our clients. This philosophy ensures our clients' best interests come first.

P2.12.text: Clients benefit when we keep asset levels in check

P2.13.text: Greater assets under management (AUM) lead to higher revenue for managers but can negatively impact existing clients' performance. Our portfolio managers are incentivized to close strategies to protect their ability to generate excess returns.

P1.2.text: Affiliated Managers Group (AMG) is a global asset management company that partners with outstanding alpha-generating independent firms.

P1.3.text: Independent investment firms have fundamental competitive advantages in generating differentiated returns.

P1.4.text: We invest in these firms through partnerships that magnify their success, as they bring their unique return streams to investors worldwide.

P1.5.text: We offer a unique approach to partnership.

P1.6.text: We provide the advantages of a long-term strategic partnership as we invest capital and resources in and alongside our partner firms while preserving their autonomy and independence. We adapt our solutions to our Affiliates’ unique strategic opportunities to create further success together.

P1.7.text: Committed to evolving and growing together.

P1.8.text: We offer powerful strategic capabilities centered around your firm’s distinct opportunities.

P1.9.text: We offer financial advisors and their clients access to investor-led independent managers with differentiated investment solutions.

P1.10.text: AMG’s global institutional distribution platform operates in key markets around the world, extending the reach of Affiliates’ business development efforts.

P1.11.text: Our Affiliates manage client assets across a diverse range of secular growth areas and are focused on creating value for their clients.

P1.12.text: Magnifying the success of independent firms around the world.

P2.2.text: Learn our history, and how we generate superior growth through partnerships with outstanding investment firms around the world.

P2.3.text: This website is designed for display in modern browsers. Your browser is not currently supported. Please use the latest version of Chrome, Opera, Firefox, Safari or Edge.

P2.4.text: AMG is a strategic partner to, and long-term investor in, leading independent investment firms globally.

P2.5.text: We provide the advantages of partnership to magnify our Affiliates’ success, while preserving their autonomy and independence. With AMG, Affiliates are able to expand their reach, diversify their business, and achieve further success.

P2.6.text: When Affiliates choose AMG as a partner, they are choosing independence. Not only do our partners value their autonomy, their clients also recognize that an independent firm’s entrepreneurial and investment-centric culture is instrumental to generating differentiated long-term returns.

P2.7.text: Having operated our distinct partnership model for 30 years, our entrepreneurial spirit, ownership mindset, and focus on excellence are deeply rooted.

P2.8.text: We generate long-term value by investing in a diverse array of high-quality independent partner-owned firms, through a proven partnership approach, and allocating resources across AMG’s unique opportunity set to the areas of highest growth and return.

P2.9.text: Diversified asset base and partnership structure enhance business stability and flexibility to invest for growth

P2.10.text: Our Affiliates maintain independence and autonomy as well as significant direct equity ownership in their individual firms.

P2.11.text: Through an AMG partnership, Affiliates’ interests stay aligned with their clients’ interests, and Affiliate management teams have the continued opportunity to participate directly in their firms’ long-term growth and success.

P2.12.text: We provide strategic and business development capabilities to our Affiliates to enhance their desired evolution toward new opportunities, and their next phase of success.

P2.13.text: Our Affiliates manage a broad array of differentiated strategies across a range of return-oriented asset classes and product structures.

P2.14.text: With more than 500 strategies in aggregate across liquid alternatives, private markets, multi-asset, and differentiated equity strategies, AMG’s business is highly diversified by asset class, client type, and geography. We are uniquely able to align our capital and resources with long-term demand trends, through growth investments in new Affiliates or alongside existing Affiliates.

P2.15.text: All EBITDA percentage data calculated as of 6/30/2026 LTM.

P2.16.text: Percentages above may not add to 100% due to rounding.

P2.17.text: For three decades, AMG has partnered with leading independent investment firms globally, building an unmatched track record of success.

P2.18.text: AMG is founded in by William J. Nutt in Boston, Massachusetts.

P2.19.text: AMG has subsequently helped the firm transition principals' ownership and align incentives across successive generations of management.
